exposure: absence of antiretroviral therapy during pregnancy
incapacity to perform viral load detection tests and CD4+ T cell counts
cohort: 198 HIV-positive pregnant women and their exposed children at the University Hospital of Santa Maria, Brazil
finding: The vertical HIV transmission rate was high (2.4%) and several factors were associated with it, including the use of injectable drugs and lack of adherence to recommended intervention measures like prophylactic antiretroviral therapy.
mod_finding: Scheduled cesarean section and the prohibition of breastfeeding significantly reduce vertical HIV transmission.
